name: FINE
description: In this paper, we propose a benchmark dataset for categorization of fabric into two tasks: i) Classification of a given material into Silk versus Non-silk. ii) Identification of viewing method-Handloom or Powerloom. In the textile domain, due to high mislabelling and imitation, identifying Silk versus Non-silk fabrics and understanding the weave methodology is important for ensuring quality, cultural preservation, and catering to consumer preference.
